project_context.name: MARCEL
project_context.theme: Light theme (Lavender/Indigo) based on existing brand, tailored for premium B2B enterprise software.
project_context.technical_constraints: CRITICAL: Pure static HTML5/CSS3. NO JS frameworks (No React, No Next.js, No Vue). NO Shadcn. One shared CSS file (or Tailwind via CDN). Vanilla JS only for mobile menu and contact form submission. Must be highly optimized for SEO and AI Crawlers (GPTBot, ClaudeBot).
project_context.language: Bilingual FR/EN. Implement via separate static HTML files (e.g. index.html for FR, en/index.html for EN) for optimal SEO and indexing.

headings.strategy: Tracking-tight for H1/H2, generous line-height. H1 up to text-5xl or text-6xl. Use strong contrast. Never center-align hero headings.

body.strategy: Clean, highly legible for enterprise buyers. text-base or text-lg for marketing copy. Left-aligned for optimal reading rhythm.

data_metrics.strategy: Use exclusively for financial figures (CAPEX/OPEX), capacity numbers, dates, and AI bot outputs to reinforce the technical/precise nature of the platform.

layouts_and_grids.strategy: Bento Grid (Tetris Mode) for Feature representations. Asymmetrical, architectural layouts that break standard SaaS boredom.
layouts_and_grids.spacing: Generous spacing system. Use Tailwind p-8, p-12, py-24. High negative space to evoke premium enterprise authority.
layouts_and_grids.hero: Asymmetrical split. Left: Crisp outcome-driven messaging and primary CTA. Right: Floating UI cards/tiles built with HTML/CSS representing the software's capability.
layouts_and_grids.features_overview: CSS Grid layout. 3-column or asymmetrical bento box displaying 'Modules'. Prioritize text-rich context for SEO.

visual_enhancers.ui_mockups: CRITICAL: Do not use generic images for the product. Build 'mock' UI elements (tiles, progress rings, status chips) using pure CSS border-radius, box-shadows, and the JetBrains Mono font to simulate the real application.
visual_enhancers.borders_and_shadows: Subtle ambient shadows (e.g. shadow-sm or custom box-shadow: 0 4px 24px rgba(53, 44, 110, 0.05)). 1px solid border (#e8e6f0) around tiles and bento boxes.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use sparingly for sticky navigation (backdrop-filter: blur(12px); background: rgba(251,250,255,0.85)). Always maintain minimum 1px bottom border (#e8e6f0) on nav.
visual_enhancers.interactive: Subtle hover states: Buttons should darken in background color; cards should lift slightly (-translate-y-1) with increased shadow.

pages_structure.index.html: Hero with H1 + CTA 'Demander une démo'. Overview of modules (Portfolio, Programs, Budgets). AI PMO Agent highlight. Footer.
pages_structure.features.html: Deep dive into each module: Portfolio, CAPEX/OPEX, Capacity, Timesheets, COMEX exports, Import MS Project. High semantic text density for SEO.
pages_structure.contact.html: Demo request form (Name, Company, Email, Message) styled with pure CSS, utilizing vanilla JS for submit handling.

media.strategy: Use architectural and high-end corporate imagery to set an authoritative tone, alongside CSS-built abstract product representations.

image_urls.description: Modern corporate architecture. Use strategically as a muted section background or with a heavy color overlay.
Dashboard analytics. Perfect for the 'Gouvernance COMEX' or 'Portefeuille' module sections.
Abstract visualization. Use for the 'Agent IA PMO' section to convey advanced AI technology.

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL RESTRICTION: Do NOT initialize a React, Next.js, or Vite-React project. You MUST create standard static HTML files (.html).

Use Tailwind CSS via the Play CDN (<script src='https://cdn.tailwindcss.com'></script>) to style the static HTML rapidly. Include font imports for Outfit, Plus Jakarta Sans, and JetBrains Mono in the <head>.
Create the HTML structure for multi-page routing: /index.html, /features.html, and /contact.html. For the English version, create an 'en' subdirectory (/en/index.html, etc.).
Build the 'Product Screenshots' purely in HTML/CSS using Tailwind. Create UI dashboard tiles, progress rings (use CSS conic-gradient), and status chips using the exact brand colors.
Focus heavily on HTML5 semantics (<main>, <article>, <section>, <nav>) and include robust <meta> tags to satisfy the strict SEO and AI crawler (GPTBot, ClaudeBot) requirement.
For interactivity (Mobile Menu toggle, Form Submission), include a small <script> tag at the end of the <body> with vanilla JavaScript. NO React states.
Do not use React icon libraries. Use inline SVGs (e.g., from Phosphor Icons or Heroicons) directly in the HTML.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Do not make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and subtle shadows.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (transition: all). Use specific transitions on hover states.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., data-testid='contact-submit-btn').
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 for icons. Use professional SVG icons.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
